# Shopify inventory sync

*Client industry: retail | Completed: 2022-09-12 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p05*

## The problem
The client was a clothing brand overselling across two stores.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using a hosted e-commerce storefront, Node.js, a JSON HTTP API, an in-memory cache in front of the database. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project eliminated overselling across 2 storefronts.
